profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA, trading under the ticker META. Its site presents AI models and tools for developers, including Muse Spark, accessed through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The site says Muse Spark is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It also describes quick start setup that points an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and search grounding that gives a model live web access through a single tool. Meta's tracked product is Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted.

The company's most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting 200966000000 USD.

Meta faces four tracked lawsuits: State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico; Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. Its recorded law exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 cases. Several MCP servers relate to Meta advertising and tools, including ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as a Meta Ads MCP server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights, and co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp and com.adbloop/meta-ads, which cover Facebook and Meta Ads automation.
